by
  intro C ι _ _ c S hS i j hij
  exact ⟨hS.δ i j hij, by rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp, S.zero, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_zero], hS.comp_δ i j hij, hS.δ_comp i j hij, hS.homology_exact₂ i, hS.homology_exact₃ i j hij, hS.homology_exact₁ i j hij⟩
target_source: ∀ (C ι : Type*) [CategoryTheory.Category C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] (c : ComplexShape ι) (S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (HomologicalComplex C c)), S.ShortExact → ∀ i j : ι, c.Rel i j → ∃ (δ : S.X₃.homology i ⟶ S.X₁.homology j) (w₁ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap S.f i) (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap S.g i) = 0) (w₂ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap S.g i) δ = 0) (w₃ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp δ (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap S.f j) = 0), (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk _ _ w₁).Exact ∧ (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk _ _ w₂).Exact ∧ (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk _ _ w₃).Exact
